tests.method: Map independently documented functions of valley temple, causeway, pyramid temple, pyramid, subsidiary pyramid and Sphinx/Sphinx Temple; test whether sequence is coherent without forcing unknown rooms into ritual labels.
Compare measured orientations across Khufu, Khafre, Menkaure and associated structures against survey/construction nulls; separate astronomical intent from cardinal construction standardization.
Pre-register candidate encoding families before inspecting ratios; test against construction constraints, metrological systems, multiple-comparisons correction and cross-monument holdouts.
List function-specific physical signatures that a real machine would require, then test residues, wear, fluid connectivity, energy balance and interfaces rather than geometry resemblance.
Search primary artifact corpus for computational devices, notation, storage media, manufacturing signatures or infrastructure that cannot be explained by known surveying/craft systems.
